review.notes: Full review; the folder is unchanged since 024927f. Findings: R01 P2: README 4.1 (:375, also :22-23, :91-92, :144-145) says its transports carry all eight Type-only Tau Ceti inputs to every universe, but nothing in 4.1 transports finrank_le_index_range_ideleClassNormMap (an extension L, ideles, norm map, index); 4.2 already transports its own statement, so narrowing the claim suffices. R02 P3: the gate fails outside-folder on Completed/LocalGaloisGroups/Suggested.lean, an edit forced by the ClassFieldTheory Suggested rewrite. R03 P3: Needs lines 8.1 (lists 7.3, which the statement does not use) and 5.1 (one line for three results). R04 P3: Suggested.lean:145 rebuilds TauCeti.WittRing.globalToLocal by hand with a redundant Invertible binder; the repair Function.Injective (globalToLocal K) elaborates and is proved equivalent in a scratch file. R05 P3: README:93 names QuadraticForm.Nondegenerate, which is not a declaration at the pin (the pinned one is QuadraticMap.Nondegenerate, Mathlib Radical.lean:115). Checked: lake env lean gives 8 sorry warnings only; #check @ of all 9 declarations matches the README; the one-tactic probe fails on all 8 sorried statements; 127 backticked external names resolved at the pins; 31 Tau Ceti and Mathlib declarations opened; the eight Type-only inputs confirmed by a binder scan. Seeded sample against milne-cft: VIII 1.1 and Ex 1.3 (p229), 3.1 (p234), 3.5 (p235), 3.7 (p236), proof of 3.5(b) (p237), 6.2 (p251), 6.3 (p252), 6.10 and 6.11 (p255), real remarks (p256) all correct. O'Meara and Serre are uncertified. Four Milne errata recorded. Gate rerun: outside-folder is the only failure. Depcheck: 238 roadmaps, 2321 edges, 0 problems. #1200 carries identical files for this folder and merges cleanly. Dropped ids (Layer 3, 4.4, main's Lean names) are mapped by the section map, and every citing roadmap was checked. Adversarial table has 28 rows with computed values.
